content_blocks.title: Reference example: Rate Limiting
content_blocks.code:
INCR api:limit:user-42
EXPIRE api:limit:user-42 60
TTL api:limit:user-42
content_blocks.run_instructions: This is a teaching sketch, not a complete race-free rate limiter. Set expiry atomically with the increment and define the exact window semantics.
content_blocks.note: Use a disposable development keyspace. Treat this as a learning example, not a production-ready policy without boundary tests.
